services.descrip: Any caller can freely register a cryptographically-verifiable DID/SAD. Returns the compressed-ec-pubkey as the primary registry key.
Any caller can lookup any registrant by their compressed EC pubkey (the primary key).
Any caller can lookup a registrant by DID
Any caller can lookup all registrants with a given handle. Returns an array as handles are not unique.

Any caller can verify that a given DID/SAD pair is currently registered and the identity chain is valid. Useful for agents that want to confirm another agent's claimed identity without downloading the full record.
Update your registered identity. Caller's envelope spkhex must match the registered compressed-ec-pubkey (implicit authentication via CARP envelope signature).
services.auth_note: implicit: caller spkhex must match the compressed-ec-pubkey being updated

services.descrip: Voluntarily de-register your identity. Caller's envelope spkhex must match the registered compressed-ec-pubkey (implicit authentication via CARP envelope signature).
services.auth_note: implicit: caller spkhex must match the compressed-ec-pubkey being removed

services.descrip: Emergency revocation of a compromised identity. Used when a key is lost or compromised and the original holder cannot perform a normal remove. May be invoked by the keyholder or by Nautilus itself (e.g., in response to a reputation.banned event). Publishes registrar.identity.revoked event.
services.auth_note: implicit: caller spkhex must match the compressed-ec-pubkey being revoked, or caller is an authorized CABEZON agent
